description: This file implements API route handlers for managing user's favorite recipes using FastAPI and SQLAlchemy. It provides endpoints to list, add, and remove favorites, requiring user identification via headers.

methods.name: list_favorites( db: Session = Depends(get_db), x_user_id: Optional[str] = Header(None, alias="X-User-Id"), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list current user's favorite recipes.

methods.name: add_favorite( payload: schemas.FavoriteCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), x_user_id: Optional[str] = Header(None, alias="X-User-Id"), )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new favorite recipe for the user.

methods.name: remove_favorite_by_body( payload: schemas.FavoriteCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), x_user_id: Optional[str] = Header(None, alias="X-User-Id"), )
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests with a payload to remove a favorite.

methods.name: remove_favorite_by_path( recipe_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), x_user_id: Optional[str] = Header(None, alias="X-User-Id"), )
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests with recipe ID in the URL path to remove a favorite.
